# done-checkmark-icon.png

**Type:** Small status icon (a blue square with a white checkmark).
**Source context:** `## Impacts identified` section, used inline three
times in the impacts table, once after each JIRA ticket entry ("AP-3771 -
Service Qualification - Add an appointment required in the response done →
CANCELLED", "AP-3772 - Introduce Stock Item identifier concept in Stock API
done", "AP-3773 - Add a Task to generate ProductOrder from ShoppingCart
backlog"). It is a status marker copied from the JIRA link and carries no
information of its own beyond the status text next to it.
